description:
In Urban Showdown, fists do the talking and the streets don’t wait. Step into a pixel-punching brawl where every alley is a battlefield and every fight is personal.

No rules. No breaks. Just waves of angry dudes, trash cans full of surprises, and a city that wants you down. But you're not here to play fair — you're here to take the whole block back.

Ready to clean up the streets? Start swinging.
name: Urban Showdown
intro: One city. One fighter. Too many problems.
